basic_profile.bio: I'm an enthusiastic gamer from Portland, Oregon, diving deep into RPGs and strategy games. When I'm not exploring virtual worlds, I'm usually tinkering with my Toyota Prius Prime or playing the ocarina. I'm a software developer by day, which lets me work remotely and gives me a flexible schedule. I usually hop onto Reddit during breaks or late at night after I've unwound from a day of coding. I'm currently single and enjoy spending time with my capybara, Maximus.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a degree from Oregon State University. My interest in gaming has been lifelong, starting from early childhood. I enjoy learning through gaming communities and forums. My knowledge of cars, particularly hybrid vehicles like the Prius Prime, comes from self-research and practical experience.
